name: @linxin666/dsh-move-session
description: Cross-workspace session migration for the dsh web GUI: a Move Session header action plus dialog (target workspace picker, keep-or-archive the original), idle-session only, full context preserved. Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && npm test
